verdict.reasoning: The printed page IV-13 (PDF p159) and page-159.md carry identical text: the heading '4.3 CONCEPT OF COMPUTER INDEPENDENT DATA DESCRIPTION' is present word for word on its own line, as are 4.3.1, 4.3.1.1 and 4.3.1.2 and every body paragraph. The only difference is markdown heading markup ('#' prefix), which is formatting, not content; the claim itself concedes 'the wording itself is intact'. The claim is also incomplete in its own terms: 4.3.1, 4.3.1.1 and 4.3.1.2 on the same page are equally unmarked (specs/ANSI_COBOL_1985.md line 6715 onward), so singling out 4.3 misdescribes the page.
